job.question: In the Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund (IMRF) sample RFP for domestic equity small cap growth investment management, on what factors are respondents evaluated and ranked during the selection process?
job.expected_facts: Four primary factors: (a) People - stability of the organization, ownership structure and documented experience of key professionals; (b) Process - clearly defined, reasonable and repeatable investment strategy; (c) Performance - documented ability to meet investment performance benchmarks; (d) Pricing - fee schedule and associated costs.
job.acceptance: Accept People, Process, Performance, Pricing and faithful descriptions; exact labels are not mandatory.

reviews.reason: This is IMRF’s sample RFP for investment consulting, real estate consulting, and performance measurement services, not the domestic equity small cap growth investment-management RFP. Its selection criteria concern consulting respondents and do not establish the four required factors for the RFP in the question.
quotes: Request for Proposals - Investment Consulting, Real Estate Consulting and Performance Measurement Services
During the selection process all respondents to the RFP will be evaluated and ranked based upon:
Organization - stability, ownership, documented experience of key professionals

Consulting Skill - investment philosophy, investment manager information collection and monitoring systems, risk management tools, performance measurement systems and breadth of consulting expertise and experience.
Fees - Consulting fees for services requested and associated costs.
